coverage_gaps: No dedicated citation-graph or DOI-metadata route is available for systematic backward and forward citation traversal; PubMed linked records and identifier searches provide only partial expansion.
No Embase or other non-PubMed subject index is available, limiting conference abstract and broader international indexing coverage.
No non-FDA regulator route is available, so actions and labels from EMA, MHRA, Health Canada, PMDA, and other jurisdictions are outside direct source coverage.
No dedicated preprint route is available; recent unreviewed safety analyses cannot be systematically assessed.
No claims or pharmacovigilance database route is available for direct reanalysis of real-world events or spontaneous reports; qualifying evidence is limited to publications indexed in PubMed.
exclusion_criteria: Records first published or regulatory actions first effective after 2024-12-31, while later metadata is retained only to flag cutoff ambiguity.
Animal, in vitro, mechanistic-only, or pharmacokinetic studies without direct relevance to the requested clinical safety outcomes.
Tofacitinib studies confined to non-rheumatoid-arthritis indications unless an FDA action explicitly applies the pivotal rheumatoid arthritis findings to marketed use or class labeling.
Efficacy-only reports lacking decision-relevant safety data or interpretation.
Narrative commentary without independently verifiable primary data, registry information, regulatory content, or evidence-integrity information.
Other JAK inhibitor evidence that neither informs a tofacitinib-specific comparison nor explains an FDA action affecting tofacitinib.
Duplicate canonical records as separate evidence units; every query-to-record occurrence remains preserved for provenance.
inclusion_criteria: Human evidence concerning marketed tofacitinib use in adults with rheumatoid arthritis.

The NCT02092467 registry record, its posted results and history, the primary publication, and identifiable secondary analyses linked by registry ID, sponsor study number, title, authorship, or study characteristics.
FDA safety communications, labeling actions, boxed warnings, and use restrictions that directly address tofacitinib or explicitly derive from the pivotal tofacitinib safety study.
Evidence reporting cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, mortality, or outcome definitions and risk factors needed to interpret those findings.
Randomized, postauthorization, postmarketing, cohort, registry, or claims-based comparative evidence capable of corroborating, qualifying, or conflicting with the pivotal study.
Corrections, errata, retractions, expressions of concern, and linked notices affecting included evidence.
Records published, posted, updated, or made effective on or before 2024-12-31; online-first, issue, registry-update, and regulatory effective dates are retained separately.

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal registry record and capture official title, sponsor study number, design, population, doses, comparators, outcomes, dates, results, and linked publications.
Recover the primary publication and verify that its trial identity matches the registry anchor.
queries.query: ("Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[Title] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Recover FDA materials explicitly linking the postauthorization trial to regulatory safety conclusions.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz "ORAL Surveillance" NCT02092467 FDA safety

queries.purpose: Retrieve broad peer-reviewed rheumatoid arthritis safety evidence across all decision-relevant outcomes without an aggressive exclusion clause.
queries.query: (("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Tofacitinib"[Mesh] OR tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer*[Title/Abstract] OR thromb*[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Find real-world evidence that may qualify, corroborate, or conflict with the pivotal trial findings.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh]) AND (observational[Title/Abstract] OR cohort[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR "real-world"[Title/Abstract] OR claims[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer*[Title/Abstract] OR thromb*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Identify related registered safety studies and verify whether NCT02092467 is the pivotal postauthorization study among rheumatoid arthritis registrations.
queries.query: AREA[ConditionSearch](rheumatoid arthritis) AND AREA[InterventionSearch](tofacitinib) AND (safety OR postmarketing OR postauthorization OR cardiovascular OR malignancy OR thrombosis OR mortality)

queries.purpose: Inventory FDA communications and labeling actions across the requested safety domains.
queries.query: tofacitinib OR Xeljanz rheumatoid arthritis safety communication boxed warning label cardiovascular cancer thrombosis mortality

queries.purpose: Confirm cardiovascular estimates and retrieve endpoint-specific analyses, subgroup qualifications, and comparator details.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]) AND ("major adverse cardiovascular event"[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR myocardial infarction[Title/Abstract] OR stroke[Title/Abstract] OR "cardiovascular death"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh]))

queries.purpose: Confirm malignancy estimates and retrieve analyses of cancer definitions, latency, subtype, and risk-factor effects.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]) AND (malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer*[Title/Abstract] OR lymphoma[Title/Abstract] OR "lung cancer"[Title/Abstract] OR "nonmelanoma skin cancer"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh]))

queries.purpose: Confirm thrombosis findings, dose relationships, event definitions, and population qualifications.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]) AND (thromb*[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembol*[Title/Abstract] OR "venous thromboembolism"[Title/Abstract] OR VTE[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR "deep vein thrombosis"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh]))

queries.purpose: Confirm all-cause and cause-specific mortality evidence and distinguish fatal events embedded in other endpoint composites.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR tofacitinib[Title/Abstract]) AND (mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract] OR fatal*[Title/Abstract] OR "all-cause mortality"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh]))

queries.purpose: Recover the FDA thrombosis and mortality action associated with the higher dose and preserve its date, indication, and dose qualifications.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz 10 mg twice daily blood clots pulmonary embolism death 2019 boxed warning FDA

queries.purpose: Recover the FDA actions based on completed postmarketing trial review and document affected products, warnings, use restrictions, and effective dates.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz increased risk serious heart-related events cancer blood clots death 2021 FDA boxed warning restriction

queries.purpose: Expand from the anchor study to secondary and subgroup analyses that may explain heterogeneity or qualify interpretation.
queries.query: (("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR A3921133[Title/Abstract]) AND (secondary[Title/Abstract] OR subgroup[Title/Abstract] OR risk factor*[Title/Abstract] OR biomarker*[Title/Abstract] OR incidence[Title/Abstract] OR follow-up[Title/Abstract]))

queries.purpose: Detect corrections, retractions, notices, or expressions of concern affecting the anchor publication or closely related safety evidence.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (Correction[Publication Type] OR Retracted Publication[Publication Type] OR Retraction of Publication[Publication Type] OR erratum[Title] OR corrigendum[Title] OR retraction[Title] OR "expression of concern"[Title]))

queries.purpose: Capture peer-reviewed updates, qualifying evidence, and integrity notices published after the primary report through the exact assessment cutoff.
queries.query: ((tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer*[Title/Abstract] OR thromb*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR correction[Title] OR retraction[Title]) AND ("2022/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication]))

question_frame: Safety PECO: among adults with rheumatoid arthritis receiving marketed tofacitinib, with special attention to patients aged 50 years or older who have at least one cardiovascular risk factor, assess through 2024-12-31 the comparative risks versus tumor necrosis factor inhibitors for major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy, venous or arterial thrombosis, and mortality. Link the pivotal postauthorization safety study across its registry record, primary publication, secondary analyses, and FDA actions; identify population, dose, comparator, endpoint, and follow-up qualifications; seek corroborating or conflicting randomized and observational evidence; and determine whether corrections, retractions, or expressions of concern alter evidence handling.
stop_rules: Stop after all three selected source routes have completed their planned sentinel, discovery, confirmation, challenge where applicable, and update events.
Require successful recovery and identity matching of NCT02092467, the ORAL Surveillance primary publication, and the associated FDA trial-based action before declaring anchor coverage complete.

Require separate evidence coverage for cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality, with population, dose, comparator, endpoint definition, and follow-up qualifications recorded where available.
Require at least one explicit search for observational or real-world qualifying evidence and one explicit search for corrections, retractions, errata, or expressions of concern.
Apply the 2024-12-31 cutoff after retrieval whenever indexing, online-first, registry-update, or regulatory effective dates are ambiguous.
Merge records by stable identifiers while preserving every query-to-record link; escalate conflicting metadata or conflicting same-identifier content for manual resolution.
Stop expansion when two consecutive anchor-linked screening passes add no new decision-relevant study, qualification, regulatory action, or evidence-integrity notice.
Stop at 16 query events and report any unfinished branch as a budget-limited coverage gap.
Permit earlier stopping only when all anchor, outcome, regulatory, challenge, integrity, and temporal requirements are satisfied and further retrieval cannot change the safety assessment.
